name: clearance-rack
prompt:
Flat vector editorial illustration for a Traditional Chinese technology-finance explainer. Canvas uniformly filled with charcoal #252525. Simple bold geometric forms, warm amber orange #ed9640 as the single focal accent, controlled steel blue #669cdb as secondary, pale warm white #f5f4f1 line accents. Low visual noise, no text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks. Centered single subject with ample margin and a clean dark perimeter that blends into a dark video backdrop.

A single amber jacket on a small steel-blue clothes rack, with one plain blank hanging tag. Treat the jacket, tag and rack as one compact centered silhouette. A few simple geometric seams, no people or store interior.
